decision_source.resolution_basis: The user replied approved directly to the sole pending L5 product-approval gate after being shown L5PAPP-1 through L5PAPP-4 and testing instructions.

rationale: The exact L5 candidate passed 10 Rust tests per run across two deterministic runs, all eight local active-runtime invariants, exact 94-event input closure, non-vacuous calculation of the 47-subject ontology, a real stdin CLI session, repeated active-state observation, exact stop and cleanup, selected-dependency currentness, and mutation probes while retaining a process-local, credential-free, network-free, production-data-free, no-external-effect boundary.

product_approval.scope: exact frozen L5 process-local active ontology runtime tested product digest only
product_approval.reversibility: A later explicit owner decision may supersede product approval; this decision and its exact candidate remain immutable history.

non_effects: This decision does not mutate the frozen candidate, test evidence, approval request, admissibility records, event corpus, or implementation bytes.
This decision preserves the prior L4 adapter admission but does not admit the complete implementation or ontology runtime.
This decision does not activate a governed or live runtime; prototype runtime activity occurred only inside the tested local boundary.
This decision does not authorize or perform migration or cutover.
This decision does not authorize publication, release, or deployment.
This decision does not grant credentials, production-data access, network access, or destructive action.
This decision does not authorize external effects or itself create a downstream activation decision.
claim_ceiling: The exact frozen L5 process-local active ontology runtime tested product is approved as a product. The L4 adapter remains admitted, but no complete implementation or ontology admission, governed or live runtime activation, migration, cutover, publication, release, deployment, credential, production-data access, network access, destructive action, or external effect is authorized or performed.
